林佳检查着洞内的其他地方，可除了地上的尸体和残破的令牌，没有找到任何有用的线索。

“没有任何其他的线索，莫奇卫肯定知道很多秘密，可惜被他们杀害了。这些人居然也自杀了……”

林佳语气凝重地说道。

李二牛叹了口气。

“现在莫奇卫死了，这些人也全部自杀了，线索彻底断了。我们再在这里待下去也没有什么意义，而且这里阴气太重，还容易惊动五仙，不如先离开这里，再从长计议。”

众人点了点头，都知道李二牛说得有道理。莫奇卫已死，线索中断，继续留在洞内，只会徒增危险。

众人小心翼翼地走出山洞，朝着黑风岭入口的方向走去，一路上大家都很沉默，心头满是震惊和不甘，忙活了这么久，最终却白忙活了。

走出黑风岭，空气中的阴气渐渐稀薄，阳光洒在身上，终于让人感受到了一丝暖意。

大家纷纷上车，准备返回青峰镇，再商议接下来的计划。

车子行驶在崎岖的山路上，杨童手里握着那块残破的令牌，眉头紧锁，神色严肃。

“这些人十分诡异，不仅手段残忍，自杀也是决然，我们面临的敌人，可能是十分强大了！”

胡九郎点了点头。

“不知道接下来我们该从哪里入手。”

车子行驶了大约半个小时，快要抵达青峰镇的时候，胡九郎突然看到路边的一片荒地上围了不少人，汐汐正站在人群中央，似乎在考察什么。

“是汐汐姐！”

胡九郎立刻让杨童停下车子，众人纷纷下车，朝着汐汐走去。

汐汐看到胡九郎，脸上露出一丝惊讶，随即走上前，笑着说道：

“胡先生，杨小姐，你们怎么在这里？难道你们也是来考察这片地的？”

“考察这片地？汐汐姐，你不是来谈生意的吗？怎么在这里考察荒地？”

胡九郎有些不解的问道。

Lin Jia checked other places in the cave, but could not find any useful clues except the corpses and broken tokens on the ground.

"Without any other clues, Mo Qiwei must have known many secrets, but it's a pity that they were killed. These people also committed suicide..."

Lin Jia said with a solemn tone.

Li Erniu sighed.

"Now that Mo Qiwei is dead, these people have all committed suicide, and the clues have been completely cut off. There is no point in staying here any longer, and the yin energy here is too strong, and it is easy to alarm the five immortals. It is better to leave here first, and then consider the long term."

Everyone nodded, knowing that Li Erniu was right.Mo Qiwei is dead and the clues are interrupted. If he continues to stay in the cave, it will only increase the danger.

Everyone cautiously walked out of the cave and walked towards the entrance of Black Wind Ridge. Everyone was silent along the way, their hearts full of shock and unwillingness. They had been working for so long, but in the end their work was in vain.

Walking out of Heifeng Ridge, the yin in the air gradually thinned, and the sun shone on the body, finally making people feel a touch of warmth.

Everyone got in the car and prepared to return to Qingfeng Town to discuss the next plan.

As the car drove on the rugged mountain road, Yang Tong held the broken token in his hand, frowning and looking serious.

"These people are very weird. Not only are they cruel in their methods, they are also determined to commit suicide. The enemy we face may be very powerful!"

Hu Jiulang nodded.

“I don’t know where we should start next.”

The car drove for about half an hour, and when it was about to arrive at Qingfeng Town, Hu Jiulang suddenly saw a lot of people gathered on a wasteland on the roadside. Xixi was standing in the middle of the crowd, seeming to be investigating something.

"It's Sister Xixi!"

Hu Jiulang immediately asked Yang Tong to stop the car, and everyone got out of the car and walked towards Xixi.

When Xixi saw Hu Jiulang, there was a hint of surprise on her face, and then she walked forward and said with a smile:

"Mr. Hu, Miss Yang, why are you here? Are you here to inspect this land too?"

"Inspecting this land? Sister Xixi, aren't you here to discuss business? Why are you inspecting the wasteland here?"

Hu Jiulang asked with some confusion.
